record_type_quote: The primary objectives of this replication report are twofold: first, I computationally reproduce the original results reported in the paper and investigate the robustness of the main treatment effects with a specification curve analysis.

targets.authors: Butera, L., R. Metcalfe, W. Morrison, and D. Taubinsky
targets.title: Measuring the Welfare Effects of Shame and Pride
targets.evidence_quote: This report replicates and extends the research conducted by Butera et al. (2022)—or BMM&T—on “The Welfare Effects of Pride and Shame.”
targets.outcome_computational_quote: The code did compile fine when using Stata 17 and produced all tables and graphs that were reported in the paper’s main body and appendices.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: The results are further robust to different sample selection criteria, adding and removing controls, and correcting for coding errors.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The original code produced all reported tables and figures using Stata 17. Correcting two minor coding errors and testing alternative controls and sample selections did not change substantive conclusions; heterogeneity analyses are extensions rather than a stated overturning of the central finding.

reasoning: Re-analysis of the original replication package, with no newly collected sample. The reference-list title is copied rather than the abbreviated wording in the report body. Only one original paper is targeted, despite multiple experimental samples.
